name: Humans
startIntroPart1: Hail, Anduin Wrynn, High King of Stormwind and leader of the Alliance. Your people have endured orcish invasion, plague and cataclysm, and each time they have rebuilt from the ashes, stone by stone and law by law.
startIntroPart2: Will you unite the kingdoms of men once more, and lead them to a lasting peace?
declaringWar: I take no joy in this. But Stormwind will defend what is hers.
attacked: You will find the Lion of Stormwind still has teeth.
defeated: The Light... it fades. Stormwind is yours.
denounced: Your deeds betray every promise you have made.
introduction: Greetings. I am Anduin Wrynn, King of Stormwind. May the Light guide us both.
tradeRequest: Stormwind's merchants have goods to offer. Shall we trade?

uniqueText: The Human Spirit: City-State influence decays 50% slower and rests 20 higher; +15% Great Person generation. For Lordaeron!: +10% Strength in your own lands. Call to Arms: when another civilization declares war on you, 2 free infantry units of your current era appear.

name: Orcs
startIntroPart1: Lok'tar, Thrall, Warchief of the Horde. Freed from the internment camps and the demon blood that once enslaved your people, you led the orcs across the sea to forge a new home in the red land of Durotar.
startIntroPart2: Will the Horde rise as a free and honorable people, or will its old bloodlust claim it again?
declaringWar: The drums of war are beating. The Horde is coming for you!
attacked: You dare strike the Horde? You will regret it.
defeated: We are defeated... but the spirits will remember our courage.
introduction: I am Thrall, son of Durotan, Warchief of the Horde. Speak your business.
tradeRequest: Durotar has goods to trade. Will you deal fairly?

name: Night Elves
startIntroPart1: Elune's blessings upon you, Tyrande Whisperwind, High Priestess and ruler of the Kaldorei. For ten thousand years your sentinels have guarded the forests of Kalimdor while the younger races squabbled.
startIntroPart2: Will the children of the stars endure another age, or will their ancient forests fall?
declaringWar: The Sentinels will hunt you through every grove.
attacked: Elune's wrath will find you.
defeated: The forests weep... we are undone.
denounced: You have betrayed the trust of the forest.
introduction: I am Tyrande Whisperwind. Tread lightly in the lands of the Kaldorei.
hateHello: You are not welcome in these woods.
tradeRequest: The Kaldorei will consider a fair exchange.
uniques: All units move through Forest and Jungle Tiles in friendly territory as if they have roads. These tiles can be used to establish City Connections upon researching the Wheel.

name: Dwarves
startIntroPart1: Hail, Magni Bronzebeard, King of Ironforge! Deep beneath the snowy peaks of Khaz Modan your people hammer steel, brew ale and dig for the secrets of their Titan makers.
startIntroPart2: Will the mountain kingdom uncover its true origins and prosper?
declaringWar: Ye've made a grave mistake. Ironforge marches!
attacked: Ye picked the wrong dwarf to anger!
introduction: I'm Magni Bronzebeard, King o' Ironforge. Pull up a stool!
hateHello: Ach, it's you. What d'ye want?
tradeRequest: Fancy a trade? Ironforge's forges are always busy.
uniques: Units ignore terrain costs when moving into any tile with Hills

name: Gnomes
startIntroPart1: Greetings, High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque! Your brilliant, diminutive people built a marvelous city of machines beneath Dun Morogh, and lost it to treachery and radiation.
startIntroPart2: Will gnomish ingenuity reclaim Gnomeregan and engineer a brighter future?
declaringWar: Gnomeregan forever! Deploy the battle-mechs!
attacked: That was a miscalculation on your part!
denounced: Your behavior has been logged as unacceptable.
introduction: High Tinker Mekkatorque, at your service! Mind the gears.
tradeRequest: We've invented something you need. Care to trade?
uniques: [+25]% Production when constructing [Siege] units [in all cities]

name: Tauren
startIntroPart1: May the Earth Mother watch over you, Cairne Bloodhoof, High Chieftain of the Tauren. Your people wandered the plains of Kalimdor for ages, hunted by centaur, until the Horde helped them find a home in Mulgore.
startIntroPart2: Will the Tauren live in harmony with the land and see their people thrive?
declaringWar: We did not seek this war, but we will finish it.
attacked: You will feel the wrath of the Earth Mother!
defeated: The Earth Mother calls us home.
introduction: I am Cairne Bloodhoof. The winds bring you to Mulgore, traveler.
tradeRequest: Mulgore offers its bounty. What do you offer in return?

name: Trolls
startIntroPart1: The loa smile upon you, Vol'jin, chieftain of the Darkspear. Once your people ruled great empires spanning Azeroth; now the scattered tribes look to you to lead them out of the shadows.
startIntroPart2: Will the trolls rise to reclaim their ancient glory?
declaringWar: Da Darkspear be comin' for ya, mon!
attacked: Ya gonna regret dat, mon.
defeated: Da spirits... dey be waitin' for me.
introduction: I be Vol'jin, chief of da Darkspear. What ya want?
tradeRequest: Got some things ya might want. Wanna trade, mon?

name: Blood Elves
startIntroPart1: Bal'a dash, Lor'themar Theron, Regent Lord of Quel'Thalas. Your people survived the Scourge's onslaught and the death of the Sunwell, and renamed themselves in honor of the fallen.
startIntroPart2: Will the sin'dorei restore the glory of Silvermoon and master their thirst for magic?
declaringWar: Quel'Thalas will not suffer your insolence any longer.
attacked: You will regret this.
introduction: I am Lor'themar Theron, Regent Lord of Quel'Thalas.
tradeRequest: Silvermoon's enchanters have wares to offer.

name: High Elves
startIntroPart1: Hail, Anasterian Sunstrider, King of Quel'Thalas. Your quel'dorei crossed the sea in ancient times and raised a shining kingdom around the Sunwell, guarded by runestones and rangers.
startIntroPart2: Will the high elves keep their realm eternal while the world around them changes?
declaringWar: The rangers of Quel'Thalas will see you fall.
attacked: You strike at the eternal kingdom? Foolish.
denounced: You have proven yourself unworthy of our regard.
introduction: I am Anasterian Sunstrider, King of Quel'Thalas.
tradeRequest: Our artisans may part with some treasures, for a price.

name: Pandaren
startIntroPart1: May the winds carry you far, Emperor Shaohao. Your pandaren have lived in harmony behind the mists for ten thousand years, guided by the August Celestials.
startIntroPart2: Will your people stay at peace, or must they step out of the mists into a world at war?
declaringWar: Balance must be restored, by force if need be.
attacked: You have disturbed our harmony.
denounced: Your path has strayed far from balance.
introduction: I am Shaohao, Emperor of Pandaria. Share a cup of tea with me.
neutralHello: Peace and good fortune to you.
tradeRequest: Our brewers have something special. Shall we trade?

name: Forsaken
startIntroPart1: Rise, Sylvanas Windrunner, the Banshee Queen. Freed from the Lich King's will, your Forsaken have claimed the ruins of Lordaeron and answer to no one but you.
startIntroPart2: Will the Forsaken find their place in a world that fears them?
declaringWar: Death comes for you.
attacked: You will join us in death.
denounced: You will regret crossing the Banshee Queen.
introduction: I am Sylvanas Windrunner. Choose your words carefully, living one.
tradeRequest: The Forsaken may have use for your goods.

name: Draenei
startIntroPart1: Light guide you, Prophet Velen. For twenty-five thousand years your people fled the Burning Legion across the stars, until the Exodar crashed upon the shores of Azeroth.
startIntroPart2: Will the draenei find a lasting home at last?
declaringWar: The Light demands justice. We will deliver it.
attacked: You have chosen the path of darkness.
defeated: We will rise again, as we always have.
introduction: I am Velen, Prophet of the draenei. The Light has foretold our meeting.
hateHello: I sense ill intent in you.
tradeRequest: The Exodar can spare some crystals. Shall we trade?

name: Goblins
startIntroPart1: Time is money, Trade Prince Gallywix! You talked, bribed and swindled your way to the top of the Bilgewater Cartel, and now the rest of Azeroth is your marketplace.
startIntroPart2: Will the goblins buy their way to greatness, or blow themselves up trying?
declaringWar: Business is business. And business says WAR!
attacked: You're gonna pay for that. With interest!
denounced: You're cut off. No more credit!
introduction: Trade Prince Gallywix! Pleasure doin' business with ya. Probably.
tradeRequest: Have I got a deal for you!

name: Worgen
startIntroPart1: Stand fast, King Genn Greymane. Behind the great wall your kingdom stood alone, until the worgen curse turned your own people into beasts of the night.
startIntroPart2: Will Gilneas master the curse and reclaim its pride?
declaringWar: Gilneas will have its vengeance!
attacked: You will feel the fury of the worgen!
denounced: You have shown your true colors.
introduction: I am Genn Greymane, King of Gilneas.
tradeRequest: Gilneas is open for trade, for now.
